title: 私が姫！プリンセスロードへ爆走です！

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: There's a dream I've held in my heart since I was a little girl.

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text: I want to become a princess.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "A princess is always beautiful, graceful, and courageous! Spitfire Cutie☆Princess Fighter!"

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text: I want to become a strong and wonderful princess, just like Princess Fighter!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text: Hic… Yes, I can… I can become a princess too…

text_block_list.name: Suntanned Boy
text_block_list.text: No way! Someone like you could never become a princess!

text_block_list.name: Girl in a One-Piece Dress
text_block_list.text: Kai's right! There's no way a crybaby like you will ever be a princess!

text_block_list.name: Boy in a T-shirt
text_block_list.text: Wah, wah! Little crybaby! Not a single person thinks you'll become a princess!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text: Sob… That's not… That's not…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That's not true!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Shush up and listen up, all you boys and girls! What she aspires to is an ideal of her own. You don't have the right to deny her pursuit!

text_block_list.name: Suntanned Boy
text_block_list.text: Wh-who are you? And why'd you just appear out of nowhere…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'll burst! I'll charge! I'll blast out of nowhere if need be! How dare you mock the dreams of another person!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Stomp! Ka-chuuuunk!

text_block_list.name: Boy in a T-shirt
text_block_list.text: Ack! Sh-she just smashed a crater into the ground!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: As a princess, it is my duty to restore love into the hearts of naughty little children who've been tainted by evil!

text_block_list.name: Young Boys and Girls
text_block_list.text: Aaaahhh! It's the savage Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Heh… It's been a while since I heard that. Everything's okay now, little lady!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text: R-right… Um, thank you…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hehe, don't mention it! It's only natural for a princess to come to the aid of someone in need!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: By the way, you were saying that you want to become a princess?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …You don't have to be afraid anymore. I sent all those bullies packing.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Plus, you and I are the same. I look up to princesses, too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text: Y-you do too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I spot Kawakami Princess talking happily with a girl in the park.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And then Princess Fighter pins the Dark Princess down with her powerful legs! Like "KER-BLAM!"

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text: …"Ker-blam?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh my, it's Trainer! Would you like to join our princess chat?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Indeed. It's a ceremony where we each speak passionately about the princesses we admire to strengthen our aspirations!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: As long as you don't lose sight of your goal and continue to be yourself, then one day, you're sure to meet people who accept you for who you are.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text: Be yourself and don't lose sight of your goal…

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text: See you later, Kawakami!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Let's meet again!
choice_data_list: Seems like you had a deep discussion.
Seems like you had a deep discussion.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I didn't want her to give up, so I kind of got carried away…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: There was a time when people told me I couldn't do it either, you see.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It was a long time ago—before I enrolled at the academy. I had visited lots of prestigious racing clubs because I wanted to work out my legs.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Friend
text_block_list.text: Are you taking the enrollment exam for that club too, Kawakami? Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text: Yes. It served as the model for the Fire-Foot Club in episode two of Princess Fighter: P♭, so I have to join!

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text: This time for sure… Third time's the charm, right? No, wait. This is the fourth time.

text_block_list.name: Club Coach
text_block_list.text: You don't really fit our criteria. And to be honest, judging from your attitude…

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… Rejected again!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Mother
text_block_list.text: Listen, dear. What you want is to become a princess, right?

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text: …Yes.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami's Mother
text_block_list.text: Then what do you have to run for? A princess needs to be ladylike and well-behaved.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No, she's wrong.

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "What you aspire to is your own! Nobody else has the right to decide for you!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: What I want to be… What I want to become is…

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "A princess is always beautiful, graceful, and courageous! Spitfire Cutie☆Princess Fighter! A dreamer's journey never ends!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I will be a princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I don't care if anyone says I don't fit, I'm not the right type, or that I can't do it! I'm going to be my own vision of a princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I want to obtain a new power, just like Princess Fighter! I want to be strong enough to win G1 races and claim the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Because I've decided to become the strongest princess! One who won't lose to anyone, no matter how daunting they are!
choice_data_list: Let's give it our all together!
Let's give it our all together!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The "Triple Tiara" refers to three G1 races—the Oka Sho, the Japanese Oaks, and the Shuka Sho. It can only be attempted during an Umamusume's classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the perfect stage for a magnificent, fiery princess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some days later, I organize a scrimmage to help Kawakami Princess get used to running in live races.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Make sure you're watching, Trainer! I'm going to do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So declaring, Kawakami Princess heads over to the gate in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she can utilize her power efficiently, then this race should be an easy win. I look on with high hopes, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thunk!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Urgh… My head…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, yes. I just lightly bumped my head on the gate. I'm completely fine, though!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite what she says, Kawakami Princess seems unsteady on her feet. I hurriedly take her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: There's no cause for concern. She's the picture of health.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Didn't I tell you? I'm totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You're worrying too much, Trainer! I'm going to go try again, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: All right… One, two! One, two! As soon as the gate opens, I'll…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thunk!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oops, my mistake… The gate totally didn't open yet…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, I know… It's just… when I think about the race, my body starts to move on its own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Based on the situation, it seems Kawakami Princess gets overexcited at the prospect of a race, preventing her from performing like normal.
choice_data_list: (…Is this going to work out for her?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Harboring a sliver of doubt, I start thinking about a method to deal with the issue.
